sn2.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Suriyo devaputto Rāhunā asurindena gahito hoti ||
sn2.10:1.3: Atha kho Suriyo devaputto Bhagavantam anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || 2.
sn2.10:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Suriyaṃ devaputtaṃ ārabbha Rāhum asurindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.10:5.4: pajaṃ mama Rāhu pamuñca suriyan ti || || 4.
sn2.10:6.1: Atha kho Rāhu asurindo Suriyaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena Vepacitti asurindo ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekam antam aṭṭhāsi ||
sn2.10:6.2: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Rāhuṃ asurindaṃ Vepacitti asurindo gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || 5.
